descripcion_geo: Fertile region of the eastern Nile delta, in Egypt, where the Israelites lived during their stay in Egypt.
importancia_estrategica: Land assigned by the pharaoh to the family of Jacob; The Israelites inhabited it for 430 years before the exodus.

historias.titulo: Joseph settles his family in Goshen
historias.descripcion: Joseph, prime minister of Egypt, settles his father Jacob and brothers in the land of Goshen, the best of Egypt.

historias.titulo: The Israelites grow up in Goshen
historias.descripcion: In Goshen the family of Jacob grew to become a numerous people; Pharaoh reduced them to slavery.

historias.titulo: The plagues did not affect Goshen
historias.descripcion: During the plagues of Egypt, God separated the land of Goshen: the Israelites did not suffer from the plague of flies, the death of livestock, darkness, or the firstborn.

personajes.descripcion: He settled his family in Goshen; His wisdom saved Israel and Egypt from hunger.
He descended to Goshen when he was reunited with Joseph; died and was embalmed in Egypt.
He was born and raised in the delta area where the Israelites lived; He left Goshen for the exodus.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Goshen: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The land protected in the midst of judgment

judaismo.descripcion: Goshen was the place where God separated his people in the midst of the plagues: the Israelites lived in Egypt but did not suffer the judgment on Egypt.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Goshen was the place where God separated his people in the midst of the plagues: the Israelites lived in Egypt but did not suffer the judgment on Egypt.

islam.descripcion: The descent from Jacob/Israel to Egypt and the stay in Goshen are narrated in the Qur'an as part of the story of Yusuf (Joseph) (Cor 12:99-100).
islam.significado_teologico: The descent from Jacob/Israel to Egypt and the stay in Goshen are narrated in the Qur'an as part of the story of Yusuf (Joseph) (Cor 12:99-100).
